user_query: I want to buy a house in Santa Monica for my family. Can you assist me in finding suitable properties for sale in the area? I would also like to get detailed information about a specific property located at 654 Pine Avenue. Additionally, I need to tokenize a confidential document related to the property purchase.

TaskList.description: 查询Santa Monica地区的待售房产信息，筛选出适合家庭的房源。
获取位于654 Pine Avenue的房产的详细信息，包括价格、面积、房屋状况等。
对涉及房产购买的机密文件进行Token化处理，以确保其安全和隐私。
